about: Sukrara Aura reference cases (SPEC.md §9). Each case: id, group, title, expect (what must be true, in words), cfg (the inputs; anything missing takes the default in SPEC.md §3). Reference renders: docs/img/aura/ref/<id>.png (390×390, the screen 1:1, no bezel). Expected numbers: expect.json. Store/web renders: docs/img/aura/store/<id>.png (1168 px with the bezel, transparent). Regenerate both with node tools/watchface/build.mjs.

cases.title: In range
cases.expect: Calm: no colour but the range green, the bead and the faint sweep at the rim; the recent readings as a sparkline beside the value (the default trend). Nothing below the value, so time and value centre and grow (time caps 76, value caps 60, top field 26).

cases.title: Rising
cases.expect: The arrow at 48° up (1.6 ÷ 3 × 90); the trail on the rail shows the last 30 minutes.

cases.title: Falling fast, in range
cases.expect: Doubled arrow from −3 mg/dL/min, vertical at the clamp. In range: no pill.

cases.title: Late
cases.expect: From 90 s the reading’s time appears under the value (10:06); the numbers grow a little less (time 64, value 56).

cases.title: Old
cases.expect: From 5 min: struck through and grey, a hollow ring for the arrow, the bead hollow, no trail, the sweep grey; the reading’s time under it.

cases.title: No readings
cases.expect: From 20 min: no value at all, “No reading since” and the time it was, large. The bead is gone.

cases.title: Long gap
cases.expect: From 12 h the weekday joins the time (Sun 19:09).

cases.title: No reading since yesterday
cases.expect: Only an hour old but from yesterday: “No reading since Sun 23:40”, the weekday with the time, since a bare clock time would read as today’s (Sukrara’s Freshness.timeText).

cases.title: No reading for a week
cases.expect: Over 6 days: the date instead of a time (“No reading since 9 Nov”).

cases.title: LO
cases.expect: Below 40: LO, no number and no trend (hollow ring); inverted on very low red; the bead pinned past the rail’s bottom end with a chevron.

cases.title: HI
cases.expect: Above 400: HI in extremely high’s colour, hollow ring, bead pinned past the top end; the pill says Insulin.

cases.title: mmol/L at its widest
cases.expect: 22.2 with one decimal, in the font's own figures and kerning: the point takes its own narrow advance.

cases.title: Low
cases.expect: The band’s colour and the need, short: ● Carbs (filled carbs pill).

cases.title: Very low
cases.expect: Inverted: white digits on very-low red, readable with no colour at all; ● Carbs.

cases.title: Low, carbs taken
cases.expect: Handled: the low alert waits 15 min after carbs; tonal carbs pill with the paused bell and 10m; the field shows ● 15g 5m.

cases.title: Muted, low
cases.expect: A mute is the paused bell and its time, in the colour of the side it holds (carbs).

cases.title: Muted, in range
cases.expect: Mute all: the crossed bell and its time left (1h 20m), neutral grey tonal pill.

cases.title: Muted until turned off
cases.expect: Mute all with no end: the crossed bell and the word Muted (Silenciadas), neutral tonal pill.

cases.title: Long mute
cases.expect: Mute all for over 6 hours: the time left in Sukrara’s compact format, whole hours from 6 h (“6h”, never “6h 40m”).

cases.title: High
cases.expect: ▼ Insulin (filled insulin pill).

cases.title: High, insulin taken
cases.expect: Highs wait 60 min after insulin: tonal insulin pill, paused bell, 45m; the field: ▼ 3u 15m.

cases.title: Quiet ran out
cases.expect: High, and the quiet after the insulin has just run out before the phone said what follows: no pill (the face never decides a need itself) until the next message; value and arrow as usual.

cases.title: Very high
cases.expect: Further up the rail, very-high orange, ▼ Insulin.

cases.title: Extremely high
cases.expect: Its own magenta from 300; a treatment never mutes it.

cases.title: Falling fast, still in range
cases.expect: Nothing to do yet, so no pill: the steep arrow and the long trail say it.

cases.title: Warming up
cases.expect: No figure that could pass for glucose: “Warming up” with a filling disc; “Ready at 10:51” on the row below. The rail has no bead.

cases.title: Almost ready
cases.expect: The disc nearly full; “Almost ready”.

cases.title: Sensor ending
cases.expect: In the last 8 h the countdown (sensor icon, 5h) takes the first bottom field.

cases.title: Ended, still sending
cases.expect: The value stays; the pill: sensor icon and Ended.

cases.title: Sensor ended
cases.expect: Readings stopped: checkered flag + “Ended” (Sukrara’s short word; the flag says it is the sensor), pill: sensor icon and Sensor (replace it). Never a last time that looks like a gap.

cases.title: Nothing paired
cases.expect: Nothing paired: “No readings” (Sin lecturas); no level rail at all.

cases.title: Phone out of reach
cases.expect: The age counts from the reading, not from delivery: it goes old by itself (struck, 9:57). The first bottom field: phone-off icon and “No phone”.

cases.title: Battery low
cases.expect: Under a day: the reserve rail’s one lit segment and its label in low red, counting hours (14h).

cases.title: Awake
cases.expect: Wrist raised, about 10 s: everything, the sweep at the rim and the dial included.

cases.title: Always-on
cases.expect: Outlined time; no sweep, top field, bottom fields, battery or dial; nothing moves from where it was. The rail keeps its notches (thin band) and the bead.

cases.title: Night
cases.expect: Between the sleep and wake times: the night palette, no sweep, no dial; nothing lights a bedroom.

cases.title: Night, low
cases.expect: A low at night still has its colour, its place and its pill.

cases.title: Private
cases.expect: No number: the value row stays empty (reserved so nothing jumps on reveal); the bead alone.

cases.title: Private, held
cases.expect: Press and hold: the number for 5 s; the neon line under it counts down (60 % left here).

cases.title: Private, act now
cases.expect: Unmasks itself when Sukrara needs you to act (needed pill).

cases.title: Private, old reading
cases.expect: The number stays hidden, but the reading’s time (10:00) shows on its row: an old reading says so without the value. Hollow bead, grey sweep and dial.

cases.title: Nothing paired, Spanish, battery days and percent
cases.expect: “Sin lecturas” fits, with the battery’s days and percent stacked beside it.

cases.title: Sensor ended, Spanish, battery days and percent
cases.expect: Flag + “Terminado” and the pill “Sensor” fit, with the battery’s days and percent stacked beside them.

cases.title: Sensor rail
cases.expect: Left: the sensor rail, a segment per day of its 15-day life, 10 lit from the bottom (9 d 9.6 h left), soft; label 9d under the time, no mark (the only segmented rail). Right: the glucose rail.

cases.title: Sensor rail, last day
cases.expect: Hours on the last day: one segment lit, label 14h, still soft (Sukrara’s countdown hasn’t started).

cases.title: Sensor rail in the countdown
cases.expect: In Sukrara’s countdown the rail and its label (5h, bold) turn amber; the automatic “sensor ending” field stays away: the rail already counts it. The bottom fields are the person’s own (time in range, treatment).

cases.title: Sensor rail ending, always-on
cases.expect: Always-on hides the sensor rail as it hides the battery and the bottom fields: nothing about the countdown shows, exactly as without the rail.

cases.title: Sensor rail ending, night
cases.expect: Night: the rail and 5h in the night amber; no automatic field.

cases.title: Sensor rail ending, private
cases.expect: Private hides the number only: the rail, its 5h and the glucose rail’s bead show; no automatic field.

cases.title: Sensor rail on both sides
cases.expect: The same rail on both sides, mirrored (both filling from the bottom), both labels 5h in amber, no marks (no battery on screen); no automatic field.

cases.title: Sensor rail, ended but sending
cases.expect: The rail unlit and no label (the Ended pill says it); the value stays.

cases.title: Sensor rail, ended
cases.expect: The rail unlit, no label; the flag message and the Sensor pill.

cases.title: Sensor rail in the warm-up
cases.expect: The rail is a progress bar: lit from the bottom along 30 % of its length (partial segments), the same fraction as the message’s pie; label 42m (minutes to ready).

cases.title: Sensor rail, almost ready
cases.expect: The bar nearly full (96 %), no label: “Almost ready” says it.

cases.title: Sensor rail ending, phone out of reach
cases.expect: “No phone” takes the first bottom field as always; the rail still counts down (5h, amber) from the dates the watch keeps.

cases.title: Sensor rail, not monitoring
cases.expect: Nothing paired: no sensor rail (as no glucose rail), “No readings”.

cases.title: Sensor rail ending, both fields steps
cases.expect: Both bottom fields set to steps (allowed) and both show: the sensor rail keeps the automatic field away.

cases.title: Sensor rail ending, a meal beside steps
cases.expect: No automatic field, so the person’s fields go through the overflow rule: steps drops, the meal stays.

cases.title: Sensor rail, dates not known
cases.expect: The phone didn’t send the sensor’s dates: the rail unlit, label --. Without an end there is no countdown, so no automatic field either.

cases.title: Sensor rail, a 10.5-day sensor
cases.expect: A Dexcom G7 (10 days + 12 h grace): 11 segments, 3 lit (2 d 12 h left), label 2d.

cases.title: Red Shift check
cases.expect: The whole screen tinted red (test only): very low still reads by inversion, the pill and its place.

cases.title: Grey check
cases.expect: Colour-blind / tinted check: high reads by its place on the rail and the pill’s triangle and word.

cases.title: Español
cases.expect: LUN 16 NOV, Hidratos, 6.420, 1 h 25 min: every word fits in Spanish.

cases.title: Default fields
cases.expect: Steps under the date; today's time in range and the last treatment at the bottom; the recent readings as a sparkline beside the value.

cases.title: After a meal
cases.expect: Sunset on top; body battery, and the meal: ▼ 4.5u ● 45g in their colours, then 35m in grey.

cases.title: A meal beside steps
cases.expect: Steps and the meal don't both fit on the arc: steps goes (the least important), the meal stays, centred: ▼ 4.5u ● 45g 35m.

cases.title: No treatment today
cases.expect: Nothing logged in the last 24 h: the treatment field goes and time in range sits alone, centred on the arc.

cases.title: Hiking
cases.expect: A second time zone on top; altitude and floors at the bottom.

cases.title: Sukrara’s own
cases.expect: Today's time in range on top instead of steps; steps and notifications at the bottom.

cases.title: Time in range not known
cases.expect: Under a quarter of the day so far, or the phone’s day over and no new message: the field says “--”.

cases.title: Long-acting
cases.expect: Heart rate on top; the last basal, ▽ 18u in its own colour, 10h ago.

cases.title: Green in range: off
cases.expect: A setting: white when all is well; the bead and the seconds sweep in Sukrara’s neon, never green.

cases.title: Green in range: very good (default)
cases.expect: 70–140 in Sukrara’s very-good green: value, bead, dial, sweep.

cases.title: Green in range: good
cases.expect: 141–179 in the yellower green.

cases.title: Battery: days and percent
cases.expect: Both labels at 9 o’clock, one over the other. Amber under 2 days.

cases.title: Battery: percent
cases.expect: Percent only. Red under a day.

cases.title: Days and percent beside a sparkline
cases.expect: The value and sparkline are too wide for the stacked label: it goes on one line (“9d · 86%”) in the gap above the value, never over it.

cases.title: Trend: arrow (default)
cases.expect: Sukrara’s arrow.

cases.title: Trend: sparkline
cases.expect: The last hour instead of the arrow, on the fixed scale (0.6 px per mg/dL): a steady hour is honestly flat. The hour and the whole range fit, so the window frames 70–180: both dotted limits and the quiet green band between them, still.

cases.title: Sparkline, turning
cases.expect: It bottomed at 60 and is coming back: the V the arrow can’t show. 60–180 still fits the window, so it frames the range with the dip just under the low line.

cases.title: Sparkline, old reading
cases.expect: The line stops short of now; struck value, hollow end, no ray.

cases.title: Sparkline with missed readings
cases.expect: Missed readings leave gaps: the line breaks there, a lone reading between two gaps is a dot, and the rail’s trail skips the missing dot.

cases.title: Sparkline, panned
cases.expect: A meal rise to 194 with the Insulin pill: the hour and the range no longer fit in the window, so it centres on the hour; the high line sits low in the box, the low line has left it (in the fade band, faint).

cases.title: Sparkline, overflowing
cases.expect: A fast rise 80 → 260 is wider than any window: the newest reading stays inside, the start of the rise is squeezed into the fade band under the box, faint but there; the scale never shrinks.

cases.title: Sparkline, a wide range
cases.expect: The person’s range is 70–250, wider than the window: it can never be framed, so the window centres on the hour; both limits fall in the fade bands, faint, and the green band fills the box.

cases.title: A short value, a longer sparkline
cases.expect: 98 is narrow, so the sparkline takes the room it leaves: the value at the row's left edge, now at the right edge where it always is, and the box wider to the left, with the time scale unchanged (100 px = the last hour): it reaches back 3 hours, the meal's whole rise and fall.

cases.title: Missed readings long ago
cases.expect: The same 3 hours with 25 minutes missed two and a half hours ago: the line breaks there; the window still frames the range from the last hour alone.

cases.title: Seconds sweep off
cases.expect: A setting: no sweep at all.

cases.title: Mirrored
cases.expect: The glucose rail on the left (still up = higher: 40 at 7:30, 400 at 10:30) with its bead, trail and notches; the battery on the right, filling from the bottom, label 9d right-aligned under the time. The dial’s focus moves left with the bead.

cases.title: Battery and sensor
cases.expect: Both segmented rails: each label gets its mark, the same size and style, on the rail’s side (battery icon 9d on the left, 9d sensor disc on the right). No glucose rail: the value, the sweep and the dial carry the level.

cases.title: Sensor and battery, high
cases.expect: Marks mirrored; the labels clear the value and the sparkline on both sides.

cases.title: Battery low, sensor ending
cases.expect: Each label in its own colour with its mark: battery 1d amber, sensor 5h amber.

cases.title: Battery days and percent on the right
cases.expect: Days and percent don’t stack beside the sparkline with a mark, so the battery label is one line (9d · 86%), right-aligned with its mark; the sensor label on the left with its own.

cases.title: Glucose rail left, sensor warm-up right
cases.expect: The warm-up bar on the right with 42m; the left rail has no bead (no value).

cases.title: Nothing on the left
cases.expect: The left side black: no rail, no label.

cases.title: Nothing on either side
cases.expect: Both sides black; the rows don’t move.

cases.title: Battery on both sides
cases.expect: Allowed: the same rail and label on both sides, mirrored; no marks.

cases.title: Glucose rail on both sides
cases.expect: Allowed: the bead, trail and notches on both sides, mirrored; the dial’s focus on the centre line (x 0).

cases.title: Glucose rail on both sides, high falling
cases.expect: Both rails with the high zone, the trail and the bead; tonal insulin pill.

cases.title: Both rails, contours
cases.expect: Contours centred on the centre line at the bead’s height.

cases.title: Both rails, glow, low
cases.expect: The glow on the centre line at the bead’s height.

cases.title: Glucose rail left, contours
cases.expect: Contours centred at x −30, the bead’s side.

cases.title: Glucose rail left, lasers
cases.expect: Lasers fade from x −30.

cases.title: Glucose rail left, glow
cases.expect: The glow on the left bead.

cases.title: Both rails, always-on, very low
cases.expect: Both rails as always-on draws one (hairline, 2 px band, notches, bead r 6); still well under Garmin’s 10 %.

cases.title: Glucose rail left, always-on
cases.expect: The left rail stays in always-on; the sensor rail on the right goes with the battery.

cases.title: Glucose rail left, night, low
cases.expect: Night palette on the left rail: the low keeps its colour, place and pill.

cases.title: Private without a glucose rail
cases.expect: Nothing places the hidden value on a scale; the sweep and the dial keep the band’s colour.

cases.title: Private without a glucose rail, high
cases.expect: A needed pill unmasks the value, as always.

cases.title: Private without a glucose rail, quiet
cases.expect: The tonal pill names the side (insulin) while the value stays hidden.

cases.title: Widest value, labels both sides
cases.expect: mmol/L 22.2 with the sparkline: the sizes step down until both labels clear the row.

cases.title: LO, Spanish, sensor right
cases.expect: The LO block clears the right label (9 d) as the left.

cases.title: Ended, Spanish, battery and sensor
cases.expect: “Terminado” clears the battery label; the sensor rail unlit with no label, so no marks (nothing to tell apart).
